name: oauth-resource-server
description: JWT bearer authentication through operator-managed HAProxy.
prerequisites: Installed operator watching generated namespaces; served MarkLogic CRD.
Delete-reclaim storage class, capacity for a two-node TLS MarkLogic cluster, and pull access to fixture images.
See marklogic-server/oauth/README.md for HAProxy requirements and coverage.

name: oauth-authorization-code
